description: Editable first-pass raw MMIO draft. EthernetDevice is UNBOUND in the current boot Namespace.
binding_notes: Current ns-state.json and raw boot-image.bin contain no EthernetDevice capability. NS[9] is an abstraction, not a device.
Historical binary c-list 0x07800400 is not a valid current device binding.
No Tunnel calls or dependency in recovered bodies. No Tunnel draft publication assumed.
Raw MMIO methods require a separately verified device binding before execution; unbound calls fault.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Raw TX_LEN write only, not delivered bytes. No DMA, FIFO loading or delivery guarantee.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Single nonblocking register read. No buffer GT, draining, timeout or framing.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: No I/O. UDP session establishment and PHY/link waiting are not implemented.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Historical 0/1/2 down/up/negotiating intent is not verified against a current device.

abi_notes: DR0 is immutable zero. DR1 is the primary result. CR7 is scratch.
SELF occupies compiler-owned row 0; EthernetDevice RW is symbolic row 1.
RETURN uses the modern implicit continuation, not CR5 instance data.
No published binary, Namespace entry, privileged grant or device binding is created.
